keyword.zh: 电动15和电动20混凝土泵的区别

title.zh: 电动15和电动20混凝土泵有什么不同

description.en: Electric 15 and Electric 20 both print 8–10 m³/h, but motor, pipe, pressure and weight are different Xingtai catalogue rows.
description.zh: 电动15和电动20都印 8–10 m³/h，但电机、管径、压力和重量是邢台目录里的不同行。

h1.zh: 电动15和电动20混凝土泵有什么不同

directAnswer.en: Electric 15 and Electric 20 are separate concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Both print 8–10 m³/h, but Electric 15 prints a 15 kW motor, a 100–125 mm pipe and 450 kg, while Electric 20 prints 22 kW, an 80 mm pipe, 10 MPa and 900 kg. Missing cells stay blank.
directAnswer.zh: 电动15和电动20是河北品锦机械在邢台的两台混凝土泵。两边理论输送量都是 8–10 m³/h，但电动15印 15 kW、管内径 100–125 mm、450 kg，电动20印 22 kW、80 mm、10 MPa、900 kg。缺的格子保持空白。

heading.en: Where Electric 15 and Electric 20 print different values
heading.zh: 电动15和电动20哪些数值不同

body.en: Motor power: Electric 15 prints 15 kW; Electric 20 prints 22 kW. Max. aggregate size: Electric 15 prints 1–3 cm; Electric 20 prints 1–2 cm. Delivery pipe diameter: Electric 15 prints 100–125 mm; Electric 20 prints 80 mm. Dimensions: Electric 15 prints 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm; Electric 20 prints 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm. The same printed value on a shared label: Theoretical output is 8–10 m³/h on both pages. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 电机功率：电动15印 15 kW；电动20印 22 kW。最大骨料粒径：电动15印 1–3 cm；电动20印 1–2 cm。输送管内径：电动15印 100–125 mm；电动20印 80 mm。外形尺寸：电动15印 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm；电动20印 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm。同一标题下数值相同的有：理论输送量两边都是 8–10 m³/h。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Electric 15 prints cells that Electric 20 does not: Vertical delivery height 15–20 m; Horizontal delivery distance 60–80 m; Total weight 450 kg. Electric 20 prints cells that Electric 15 does not: Max. outlet pressure 10 MPa; Hopper capacity 0.25 m³; Pumping distance (H / V) 120 m / 40 m; Main unit weight 900 kg. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 电动15有、电动20没有的行：垂直输送高度 15–20 m；水平输送距离 60–80 m；整机重量 450 kg。电动20有、电动15没有的行：最大出口压力 10 MPa；料斗容积 0.25 m³；输送距离（水平/垂直） 120 m / 40 m；整机重量 900 kg。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: The shared 8–10 m³/h band does not make the pipe, motor or weight interchangeable. Open /en/products/electric-15-concrete-pump/ for Electric 15 and /en/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/ for Electric 20. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 相同的 8–10 m³/h 不能把管径、电机或重量互相挪用。看电动15请打开 /zh/products/electric-15-concrete-pump/，看电动20请打开 /zh/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Electric 15 print the same motor power as Electric 20?
question.zh: 电动15和电动20的电机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 15 prints 15 kW. Electric 20 prints 22 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动15印 15 kW。电动20印 22 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 15 print the same max. aggregate size as Electric 20?
question.zh: 电动15和电动20的最大骨料粒径一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 15 prints 1–3 cm. Electric 20 prints 1–2 cm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动15印 1–3 cm。电动20印 1–2 cm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 15 print the same delivery pipe diameter as Electric 20?
question.zh: 电动15和电动20的输送管内径一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 15 prints 100–125 mm. Electric 20 prints 80 mm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动15印 100–125 mm。电动20印 80 mm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is vertical delivery height missing on Electric 20?
question.zh: 为什么电动20没有垂直输送高度？

answer.en: The Electric 20 page does not print that label. Electric 15 prints 15–20 m. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 电动20这一页没有印这个标题。电动15印的是 15–20 m。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
